content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Draw and label tree diagrams for two or more successive events
Apply the AND rule (multiply along branches) for combined events
Apply the OR rule (add between outcomes) for alternative events
Calculate probabilities for independent events using tree diagrams
Solve problems involving coins, dice, spinners, and other contexts
